report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and Redis/Postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. Deployment record only proves order 1.0.0 with no prior version. No evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off.
